a: EC2 provides virtual machines in the cloud.
S3 is object storage for files, backups, and static assets.
RDS manages relational databases with backups and failover options.
Lambda runs functions without managing servers (serverless).
IAM controls identities, roles, and permissions in AWS.
VPC is your isolated virtual network with subnets and routing.
SQS is a queue; SNS is pub/sub fan-out messaging.
ECS runs containers on AWS; EKS is managed Kubernetes.
CloudWatch provides metrics, logs, and alarms.
